## Analysis / root cause
The engine already has the ground truth: the run DAG skeleton (server.ts /api/workflows/:name/skeleton successor, dashboard.ts layoutGraph) is derived from the script's phases and agent calls, and run_status carries the live agent order and parallel groups. The author diagram is only label-diffed, so a viewer cannot trust the arrows, and the authoring guide's sentence "the checker matches your diagram against your script edge by edge" overstates what is enforced (it only refuses `&` fan-out). Suggested fix, in increasing effort: (a) reword the guide to say only the label set is checked; (b) derive an expected edge list from the script skeleton (sequential agent calls → edge, parallel() members → same column, if/else → diamond) and raise DIAGRAM_MISMATCH or at least a mermaidNote when the author's edges disagree; (c) render the derived graph beside the author's on the dashboard and highlight the diff. ## Analysis / root cause
The `seed` path accepts a {path, sha256} entry without INVALID_SEED_SPEC, creates the file, but never resolves the sha256 against the caller's CAS pool; the entry is treated as an inline-content entry with no content. `seedManifest` resolves the blob correctly. Either `seed` entries carrying only sha256 should be refused (INVALID_SEED_SPEC or MISSING_BLOBS) or they should resolve the blob like seedManifest does. Silent empty files are the worst outcome: five agent runs executed on empty workspaces before the cause was found, and the authoring guide does not document the seed shapes at all.
